why: The moves are named file by file with line numbers that hold today (StorePreviewPageView 277, PreviewPageView 231, the guard entries at 45 and 48, the three helpers load/editedElsewhere/themeStoreView that both the platform preview and editor use), and the type check, permissions.scan and the marker counter catch most wrong moves. But it is some forty files across stores, platform and sandbox, it makes the custom-field rich text editor lazy inside forms that save order, customer and product data, and the only check that typed text survives an early Save is a manual one a cheap model can skip; budgets in admin-scripts.spec.ts are set from its own measurement.
harm_if_wrong: A rich text custom field on an order, customer or deal that saves empty or loses its text when Save is pressed before the editor's script loads, or a preview route whose access check was dropped in the move, both passing the unit checks.
make_it_cheaper: Name the exact helpers to move into platform/pages/page-load.ts (load, editedElsewhere and themeStoreView, all three used by both views) and turn the hand check of an early Save into a signed-in Playwright case, so commits 1 and 2 need no reading beyond the brief.
brief_problems: 'Move StorePageTermsView here from views.tsx (line 229 to its end)' can be read as line 229 to the end of the file, which would carry FrontPageForm, ProductsPageForm, PageRoleForm, ProductLayoutsTable and roleOffered (lines 267-480) that the list view uses; it means the end of the function.
The admin-scripts.spec.ts change leaves a choice (add {order} from the seed or leave the order entry out).
